a.name: SECTOR A
a.title: File Archive
a.description: The virus scrambled all the files! Complete tasks to free the sector.

task1.title: Sort files into folders
task1.description: The virus mixed up all the files! Sort them into the correct folders.
task1.hint: Think about what each file is for. Is an antenna for communication or engines?

task2.title: Find file by path
task2.description: The virus hid important files! Find them in the explorer using the given path.
task2.hint: Read the path from left to right. Each / means entering a folder.

task3.title: Fix folder structure
task3.description: The virus mixed up the folders! Restore the correct structure using the example.
task3.hint: Look at the example on the left. Which folder should be inside Mission?

b.name: SECTOR B
b.title: Graphics Station
b.description: Graphics files are damaged! Use Sumo Paint to restore them.

task1.title: Fix circuit board (simple)
task1.description: The virus damaged the control board! Fill the damaged elements with the correct colors.
task1.hint: Use the 'Fill' tool (bucket). Select a color from the legend and click inside the element.

task2.title: Fix circuit board (complex)
task2.description: This board is more damaged! Fill all elements and draw the missing component.
task2.hint: Don't forget: 1) fill all 6 elements with correct colors, 2) draw something in the center!

task3.title: Match the tools
task3.description: The virus mixed up tool names! Match each tool with its function.
task3.hint: Remember which tool you used to fill elements with color? What do you use to erase mistakes?

c.name: SECTOR C
c.title: Documentation Center
c.description: Documents are damaged by the virus! Fix errors and restore formatting.

task1.title: Fix text errors
task1.description: The virus corrupted an important document! Find and fix all errors in English words.
task1.hint: How do you spell 'file' correctly: 'flie' or 'file'? Check each word carefully.

task2.title: Format the text
task2.description: The virus reset all formatting! Format the text according to the example on the left.
task2.hint: Select 'COMPUTER RULES' and press B (bold). Select the three action lines and press the list button.

task3.title: Fill in missing words
task3.description: The virus erased important words! Drag IT terms to their places.
task3.hint: Where do you save files? In a folder! What do you use to open websites? A browser!

d.name: SECTOR D
d.title: Command Center
d.description: The mission presentation is destroyed! Restore it in WPS Presentation.

task1.title: Arrange slides
task1.description: The slides are mixed up! Arrange them in the correct order.

task2.title: Add titles
task2.description: Slides 2, 3, 4 have no titles. Add them based on the images.

task3.title: Fix design errors
task3.description: Some slides have problems. Find and fix them.

d.hint: Check: 1) First slide — 'Mission to Mars', last — 'Launch!' 2) Slides have titles 3) Text is readable

virus.intro: Ha-ha-ha! I've captured your spaceport! Try to stop me!
virus.locked: Ha! This sector is locked! Free the others first!
virus.sector_a_defeated: No! How did you free the file archive?! It means nothing!
virus.sector_b_defeated: Aaa! My graphics station! But I still have the documents!
virus.sector_c_defeated: Impossible! You're too smart... But you'll never crack the presentations!
virus.sector_d_defeated: NOOOO! You ruined everything! But I'll be back!!!
